notes.title: Elevator Experience Patch - 1
notes.content:
Problems and improvements that we fixed with the last update as Elevator Experience developer team

[b]Bugs[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed the issue of being able to move around in bed on the start scene
[*]Fixed crouching issue in bed on the start scene
[*]Fixed the problem of not being able to take a Rubik's Cube
[*]Fixed saving issue in some rooms
[*]Fixed translation errors in some languages
[/list]

[b]Improvements[/b]
[list]
[*]Changes in the laser room
[*]Changes in mannequin room
[*]New UI's
[*]Guide LCD screen added to the elevator
[/list]

As Elevator Experience developer, we value all your feedback. Thank you for your support <3
